rca_of_issue: Playwright + hidden RN-Web TextInput incompatibility. Root cause: /otp uses a single hidden `<TextInput style={styles.hiddenInput} autoFocus maxLength={6}>` with `onChangeText` auto-submitting on 6 digits. On React-Native-Web this compiles to an `<input>` with near-zero visual footprint. Playwright's locator.fill() first tries to focus the element via a click on its center — when the center is 1x1px and the element is already autoFocused, the focus-round-trip can no-op, and then the synthetic input event may fire on the wrong document target. Result: onChangeText doesn't get triggered → state stays at '' → auto-submit doesn't run → boxes stay empty. Mitigation for the harness (NOT production): call /api/auth/verify-otp directly and inject the JWT into localStorage, or expose a visible dev-only input when EXPO_PUBLIC_E2E=1. NO code change made to production — the migration itself is correct and users on real devices will hit the native keyboard path which is unaffected.
